display.purpose: Focal two-line Ship It. title only; rendered in the self-hosted italic display face.

headline.purpose: The participant's obvious, short-measure copy target.

body.purpose: Muted action guidance beneath the edit target.

label.purpose: Uppercase header, footer, chapter, and status notation.

code.purpose: Literal filenames and code references in workshop instructions.

shadows.name: signal-halo
shadows.purpose: A restrained halo around the header's orange inspection mark; never surface elevation.

motion.name: ring-settle
motion.value: 1050ms ease-out both; scale(.92) rotate(-5deg) to scale(1) rotate(0) through two damped overshoots
motion.purpose: One visible-default entrance for the single oversized signal ring.

motion.name: status-pulse
motion.purpose: Restrained readiness pulse on the footer status dot.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses all animation when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Inspection Mark
components.description: Uppercase workshop mark with a live orange inspection dot.
components.css: .ds-inspection-mark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; color: var(--ink, #161713); font-family: "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-inspection-mark::before { content: ""; width: .72rem; height: .72rem; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--signal, #f04b23); box-shadow: 0 0 0 .3rem rgba(240, 75, 35, .15); }

components.name: Registration Label
components.description: Desktop-only vertical scrutineering notation bracketed by ink ticks.
components.css: .ds-registration-label { display: grid; gap: .55rem; color: var(--muted, #5d5d55); font-family: "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .55rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .14em; writing-mode: vertical-rl; } .ds-registration-label::before, .ds-registration-label::after { content: ""; width: 1.4rem; height: 1px; background: var(--ink, #161713); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-registration-label { display: none; } }

components.name: Editorial Edit Target
components.description: The unmistakable participant-owned sentence beneath an inspection rule.
components.html: Edit this text to make it yours.
components.css: .ds-editorial-panel { padding-top: 1.2rem; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #161713); background: var(--paper, #f1efe8); } .ds-editable-target { max-width: 13ch; margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #161713); font-family: "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4.5rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.035em; line-height: .95; } .ds-editable-target em { color: var(--signal, #f04b23); font-style: normal; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-editable-target { font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 10vw, 3.6rem); } }

components.name: Workshop Hint
components.description: Muted instruction with the exact edit file emphasized in monospace.
components.html: Open app.js, find this sentence, and give your build a voice.
components.css: .ds-workshop-hint { margin: 1.5rem 0 0; max-width: 42ch; color: var(--muted, #5d5d55); font-family: "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-workshop-hint code { color: var(--ink, #161713); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Ready Status
components.description: Terse readiness label with a restrained pulsing signal dot.
components.css: .ds-ready-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; color: var(--ink, #161713); font-family: "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ready-status::before { content: ""; width: .5rem; height: .5rem; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--signal, #f04b23); animation: ds-status-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-status-pulse { 50% { opacity: .35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ready-status::before { animation-duration: .01ms; animation-iteration-count: 1; } }

components.name: Signal Ring
components.description: One oversized orange ring with a damped, non-looping entrance.
components.css: .ds-signal-ring { width: min(46vw, 42rem); aspect-ratio: 1; border: clamp(3rem, 9vw, 9rem) solid var(--signal, #f04b23); border-radius: 50%; transform-origin: center; animation: ds-ring-settle 1050ms ease-out both; } @keyframes ds-ring-settle { 0% { transform: scale(.92) rotate(-5deg); } 56% { transform: scale(1.035) rotate(1.2deg); } 78% { transform: scale(.985) rotate(-.4deg); } 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-signal-ring { animation-duration: .01ms; animation-iteration-count: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
Ship It. looks like a machine has passed inspection and is waiting for release: a warm paper field, near-black inspection ink, terse technical notation, and one decisive orange signal. The interface is spare enough that the editable sentence remains unmistakable, while the oversized italic title and off-canvas ring give the tiny workshop starter a memorable identity.

The system is flat, exact, and energetic rather than glossy. Large negative fields separate the display title from the edit target; registration ticks and status language supply the scrutineering character without competing with the participant's next action.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and inspection ink carry nearly the entire surface.
Signal orange is rare, semantic, and visually decisive.
Condensed-feeling italic display lettering contrasts with terse sans-serif labels.
Desktop composition uses an asymmetric two-column field; mobile becomes a single stack.
Motion is limited to one damped entrance and one restrained readiness pulse.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange identifies the active signal or exact point of attention; it does not become general surface decoration.

rules.name: The Paper Field Rule
rules.body: Preserve the broad warm-paper field so type, rules, and the signal ring carry the hierarchy without panels or fills.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Ship Display only for focal editorial lettering; all operational and instructional language stays in the sans-serif inspection voice.

rules.name: The Exact Target Rule
rules.body: The participant's editable sentence must remain a large, short-measure headline, with the words that invite ownership picked out in signal orange.

rules.name: The Open Field Rule
rules.body: Do not fill the negative space with extra cards, badges, or explanatory modules; the emptiness is what makes the edit target obvious.

rules.name: The No Surface Shadow Rule
rules.body: Keep content on one paper plane; never use shadows to turn text groups into floating panels.

dos: Do reserve signal orange for focal words, readiness, focus, selection, and the single ring.
Do keep the editable sentence and its literal file path immediately visible and unambiguous.
Do preserve the desktop registration detail and remove it cleanly at the mobile breakpoint.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences by collapsing animation to a single near-instant iteration.
donts: Don't add gradients, surface cards, decorative shadows, or rounded content containers to this flat inspection world.
Don't repeat the large signal ring or scatter orange accents until they lose semantic force.
Don't use Ship Display for instructions, labels, or body copy.
Don't carry desktop registration ticks into the mobile content stack.
